correctness.rationale: For the exact unnormalized linear map on Herm_3, the angular Fourier transform at each orbit has real row norms 1/sqrt(3), 1/sqrt(6), 1/sqrt(6) with orthogonal rows, giving the claimed sqrt(3)/18 Jacobian. The diagonal block has determinant Delta_2/2, and the complex off-diagonal block has determinant of modulus (r1 r2 r3)/2 times |−Au1+Bu2−Cu3|. Its modulus squares in real coordinates, with an additional factor 2^-3 from the Hilbert–Schmidt coordinates. Combining the Gaussian and Fourier factors gives 81 sqrt(3)/8. Factoring B−A−C gives the strictly positive Vandermonde in the radii; both triangle-inequality equality conditions are exact since A,B,C>0. At the maximizing phases, the radial log-objective has Hessian at most −6I on the convex ordered cone. The Gaussian and the vanishing wall factors give an interior maximum, strict concavity gives uniqueness, and differentiating in the scale direction gives 6 sum(r_i^2)=18. value.rationale: A saturated equally weighted nine-measurement design on the full Hermitian space is a natural constrained tomography problem. The determinant quantifies how choices of offsets affect the linear measurement volume, even though all offsets are informationally complete, and gives both sharp orientation requirements and a reproducible unique radial optimum. This is useful within the stated three-orbit family without claiming optimal design over arbitrary placements or noise models.
